The '''Ambush against PLT Depot 5''' was a skirmish in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] that took place in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] or earlier. A textbook Rebel raid on Imperial Navy Supply Depots, the operation resulted in Alpha Squadron eliminating two Rebel squadrons as well as a group of Heavy Lifters sent in to steal supplies when they attacked [[PLT Depot 5]].

==Battle==
{{Quote|Alpha 1 reporting in: patrolling for craft to attack|[[Alpha Leader/Legends|Alpha 1]] to [[Alpha Squadron]], just before engaging Blue Squadron|<ref name="TIE Fighter" />}}
During a routine patrol around the Imperial Navy supply depot known as [[PLT Depot 5]], Alpha Leader found [[Blue Squadron]], a [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] squadron tied to the Rebel Alliance, approaching the depot and moved in to engage, also contacting his squadron with his status report when encountering them. Shortly afterwards, PLT Depot 5, having detected more Rebels exiting Hyperspace, ordered [[Alpha Squadron]] to engage and eliminate the invaders. They then got an alert of four [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighters]] in the area belonging to Gold Squadron attacking the platform. Eventually, more X-Wings belonging to Gold and Red Squadrons entered in. Alpha 1 eventually got shot down, with Alpha 2 taking command. The newly promoted Alpha 2 then ordered his wingmen to target Red 2 while Alpha 2 took care of Red 1.

Eventually, several [[Heavy Lifter/Legends|Heavy Lifters]] belonging to the group [[Pelican]] began targeting the depot's [[Class-E cargo container]]s, requiring Alpha Squadron to destroy them before they could successfully steal their contents, with Alpha 2 targeting three of them. At that moment, the ''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer ''Colossus'' exited hyperspace and offered assistance to Alpha Squadron and PLT depot 5 by dispatching squadrons of TIE/IN interceptors and TIE/sa bombers to deal with the rebels, as well as utility tugs to retrieve any Class E cargo containers that had been stolen. Upon the Rebels being driven off, the commanding officer noted that the Rebels were getting bolder, although at the same time, the Rebels haven't gotten any smarter.

==Aftermath==
The events of the ambush were immortalized as one of the Galactic Empire's Combat Training sequences for newly ordained [[TIE pilot]]s within the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]], specifically for upcoming pilots of the [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighter]], with then-rookie pilot [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] eventually assuming the role of Alpha 2 for this simulation, also earning the Bronze [[TIE fighter combat medallion]] for participation in this as well as basic exercises. It was often used to highlight to newcomers the relationship between a [[Flight leader|Flight Leader]] and his Wingmates, and to a lesser extent to teach them about the use of the targeting computer's memory locations for important objectives and issuing flight orders to other wingmen.

==Behind the scenes==
The Ambush against PLT Depot 5 first appears in the [[1994]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']]. It is the second Combat Training mission for the TIE Fighter, titled "Flight Leaders & Wingmen."

If the player takes long to complete the mission, the Imperial Star Destroyer ''Colossus'' will arrive with reinforcements. Although the strategy guide does not mention the ''Colossus'' getting involved, this article assumes it did.
